text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking through the 
twilight-colored town with Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Ahead of us—a vortex of 
"humans."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Getting "rowdy" over a spherical 
projectile being fired, huh. This is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They were abstract words, but essentially—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting 
lottery draw! Hey, Umamusume with the 
ahoge standing up over there, wanna give 
it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A raffle lottery... Quantifying luck with 
a 'rattle-rattle-pop', huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The entry ticket is—
choice_data_list: It's right here. Just one sheet, though.
It's right here. Just one sheet, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand the precious single ticket to the 
old shopkeeper. There's no turning back 
now.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
There is only one chance... Neo Universe's 
energy is finite. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we combine the will of the "EXAL"s with 
Trainer's power...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe gathers her energy and 
directs it toward the raffle machine. 
Riding that momentum, the two of us crank 
the lever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A swirling galaxy. The star ejected from 
it—what magnitude will it be?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A "Cepheid-class"... fixed star is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that ticket permits you to stay 
at the facility. So...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Departing on—a "Hot Springs Trip".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe's figure... suddenly 
vanished from sight."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Fwump...)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Why... aren't you coming?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looked like... she had teleported, but 
that's impossible. And of course, there 
was no way I could keep up with her.
choice_data_list: Do you know what a hot spring is like?
Do you know what a hot spring is like?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I think I grasp... the structure. In 
other words, the 'hot spring' is—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The center of this planet. The "water" 
heated in the upper mantle near its 
surface...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It settles once, and along with various 
components... erupts to the surface. In 
other words—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...It'll turn into 'fun.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going from an explanation straight to 
"fun" was quite a leap, but she's 
certainly looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe can see the "cycle."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"We can 'synchronize' next March. So, 
until then..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Increase the speed further, synchronize—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do our best and get results!

Yeah, let's do our best and get good 
results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring trip is only meaningful with 
great results behind it. Neo Universe 
accelerated even further toward the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A first-magnitude star—"Special Deluxe 
Carrot Hamburg Steak"! This shape is... 
"familiar."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen it, but I felt it. This 
shape is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A spearhead galaxy piercing the Cartwheel 
Galaxy... Closely resembles a "major 
merger."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never thought a talk about hamburger 
steaks would turn into a discussion about 
colliding galaxies.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe recommends. This 
Salisbury steak is......"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "TRYK"—is optimal.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Teriyaki"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I shaped the Salisbury steak 
into "TRYK" as requested. Perhaps it was 
just my imagination, but it tasted a bit 
intellectual.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Carrots—a whole mountain of them. An 
astronomical amount...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, for every single one of these 
carrots—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "EXAL"s do exist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I can only say, 'I see.' If that's what 
they say. And—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following Neo Universe's lead, carrying 
that pile of carrots, I arrived at a small 
hill at night."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we are here... We can deliver one 
bottle to every single "EXAL"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, close your eyes so you don't 
become "noise".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Closing my eyes as instructed, and opening 
them once again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The carrots... were completely gone. As if 
they had been sucked right up into thin 
air.
choice_data_list: Did you really take it with you?
Did you really take it with you?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Rather than taking it, it's more like Neo 
Universe "dedicated" it. And once the 
"dedication" was complete—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "I 'ate by myself.' My 'tummy is full'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Eat after offering..." Through a ritual 
that closely resembled a sacred offering, 
Neo Universe managed to gain her 
nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A carrot... Just one... This shape...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you know what a "rocket" is?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The shape... strikingly similar. Carrots 
become rockets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that's true. Many 
root vegetables are shaped a lot like 
rockets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I really could get a rocket...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like the two of us could even go 
on a space journey together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there is a "hierarchy" to these 
prizes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The grand prize is a "Hot Spring Trip." If 
third prize is a "Space Trip"—the balance 
cannot be maintained.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe and the others can't go to 
outer space. That's 'SALD'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was feeling down. Putting an 
end to the daydreaming and returning to 
reality, she decided to nibble on a 
carrot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Ti, ssue... Tissue... This scrap of paper 
is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I can see... the carved signature... This 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if having a nightmare, Neo Universe 
began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The yellow-masked... Fighting General... 
Captivating... Sma... rt... to...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That dazzling radiance is... passed 
d-down... Ro... Ro...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Neo Universe... saw the 
"taboo"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—A rectangular, three-dimensional object. 
That is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is unbelievably exhausted. The 
consolation prize brought a far greater 
negative impact on Neo Universe than 
expected.
